nodes.label: Row Level Security Policies & Helper Functions (0002_rls_policies.sql)
nodes.rationale: Enables RLS on all 21 tables and storage.objects using 13 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER helpers (is_chat_member, is_blocked_either_way, is_contact, can_view_avatar, can_view_story, etc.), enforcing RPC-only writes on sensitive tables, 15-minute message edits, 1-hour delete-for-everyone, and bidirectional fair-trade read receipts.

nodes.label: profiles_visible Column-Level Privacy View
nodes.rationale: Because Postgres RLS is row-level and cannot mask columns, profiles is restricted to self-only SELECT while profiles_visible (with security_invoker = false, security_barrier = true) masks avatar_url via can_view_avatar(), masks last_seen_at via presence_visible, and filters out blocked users.
